title: Robert Saleh: Cam Ward's accuracy isn't a concern, every QB misses a couple

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh: Cam Ward's accuracy isn't a concern, every QB misses a couple
sources.description: Titans quarterback Cam Ward hasn't always been his sharpest at OTA practices while learning the team's new offense this spring, but missed passes aren't a concern for the guys calling the shots on the coaching staff.
